subject: Conversion request: Contractor Nate Remy — comp & headcount approval

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>

Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>

Subject: Contractor -> FTE: Nate Remy — proposed comp & headcount request

Hi Marissa and Michael,

I would like to request approval to convert Nate Remy (currently a contractor on Platform SRE) to a full-time role. Nate has been contracting with us since May 2025 and has taken ownership of the CI/CD reliability work that was blocking several launches. Team feedback and metrics (incident MTTR down 23% quarter-over-quarter) strongly support bringing him on full-time.

Proposed conversion details:
- Candidate: Nate Remy (contractor) — nate.remy@contractors.com
- Role: Senior Site Reliability Engineer (IC4) — reports to Michael Grant
- Start date (target): 2026-04-01
- Headcount: Convert existing contractor headcount; request approval to move to FTE (Headcount Req #9876 attached)

Comp package (initial draft):
- Base salary: $170,000/year (within IC4 band, request confirmation)
- Sign-on bonus: $10,000 (to offset 2 weeks of contractor notice + benefits ramp)
- Equity: 0.12% RSU grant, 4-year vest (1Y cliff)
- Eligibility: Full benefits, 401(k) participation, standard Redwood PTO

Attachments: draft offer (2026-03-01_NateRemy_offer_draft.pdf), comp band reference (comp-band-IC4.pdf), headcount req form (headcount-req-9876.pdf).

Cost-impact note: ongoing run-rate ~ $170k + payroll burden, sign-on one-time $10k. I can provide a 12-month cost projection if helpful.

Asking: Marissa, can you confirm comp band alignment and formal offer language? Dev, can you confirm budget/GL code for the FTE conversion? Michael, please confirm manager approval for the proposed title/level.

If everyone signs off, I will convert the draft into a DocuSign offer and send to Nate (he's open to an April start).

Thanks —
Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Platform Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachments: 2026-03-01_NateRemy_offer_draft.pdf (PDF, 85KB); comp-band-IC4.pdf (PDF, 110KB); headcount-req-9876.pdf (PDF, 42KB)

Subject: Re: Contractor -> FTE: Nate Remy — proposed comp & headcount request

Thanks Laura — quick read and thumbs up in principle. A few comments: 

- Comp band: IC4 band max for US West is $160k - $175k (see attached comp-band-IC4.pdf). $170k is within band but near midpoint. If you want a stronger retention signal we can do $168k base + $10k sign-on, or $170k with a clause tying the remaining comp to performance after 6 months.
- Equity: 0.12% is reasonable; we'll translate that into the appropriate RSU tranche. Confirm whether the grant should be at market refresh or front-loaded.
- Sign-on: limited to $15k discretionary for conversions in this quarter; $10k is fine.
- Benefits eligibility note: he'll be eligible day one for health; other perks follow standard new hire timelines.

Please add a one-paragraph manager performance milestone to the offer (6-month review and retention bonus eligibility) — helps with approvals.

Also, ensure the headcount req (9876) is updated to show the contractor code being decommissioned; otherwise Finance will flag it.

If you want, I can draft the final offer language and run it through Legal.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
People Operations Partner
Redwood Inference
